description: Implementation of StaticContentFileManager that handles file operations such as add, remove, and retrieve static content files for a merchant store.

classes.name: StaticContentFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of StaticContentFileManager for managing static content files within a merchant store environment.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single static content file for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store, typically images or related content.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file based on content type and filename for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file for a merchant store based on content type and filename.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists filenames of static content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of static content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files for a merchant store.
